title: `connectPagination` sometimes provide outdated properties
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

When updating the query to a query that returns less hits, `connectPagination` sometimes provide outdated properties.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

I couldn't reproduce in a sandbox, but here are some steps to reproduce the issue on our website:

1. Go to https://www.studeersnel.nl/nl/search/Exam-AESB?institutionId=1
2. Update the query to be `Exam AESB311`
3. Press Enter
4. See incorrect pagination
5. Reload, you'll see that the pagination disappears

Also, [here is](https://www.loom.com/share/2ee00e037991435395795a2d74be4e7f) a video showing how `connectPagination` provides outdated properties, as opposed to, for instance, `connectStateResults.

## 💭 Expected behavior

`connectPagination` should return the correct number of pages at all time.

## Environment

- OS: MacOS
- Browser: Chrome
- Version: 6.23.0

comments.body:
Hmm, I can reproduce this on your site, but not on a standard InstantSearch implementation, is this something you can reproduce in a site closer to your real one? https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/react-instantsearch

Not sure which features you're using that could impact this, you mentioned multi-index earlier, maybe that's relevant?

We don't have multi-index yet in production. We're using server-side rendering, and, in order of appearance:

- `connectSearchBox` for the search bar
- `connectStateResults` for tracking purposes
- `connectHits` for the search results
- `connectPagination` for the pagination
- `Configure` component

I'll see if I can reproduce in another environment, but so far haven't been able to.

@Haroenv It's very hard to reproduce in the sandbox, because even on our website it doesn't always happen. For instance updating the query from `economic` to `economic101` does update the page count correctly [here](https://www.studeersnel.nl/nl/search/economic?institutionId=1). 

Is there another way to get the current page in any of the other HOC? I can't seem to find it in `connectStateResults` (where we can find the number of pages, though).
Sorry, I missed your response here @Ksntcrq. The page number is available in connectStateResults too: https://codesandbox.io/s/nice-hertz-zz3w8m?file=/src/App.js

@Haroenv I have another interesting finding. The issue also happens in `stateResults` provided by `connectStateResults` but only if `connectStateResults` is _after_ the hits. See here on the following screenshots, `connectStateResults` does not provide the same values when before/after the hits: I remember there was an issue depending on the order of the components [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/5255) as well. Maybe this will give you a lead?

I forgot about that issue and it indeed sounds the same. On another note, have you tried out React InstantSearch Hooks? We have components available now too, and its organisation is simpler, so issues like these should no longer be possible
Oh I didn't know your hooks were finally production-ready, we'll take a look! Thanks.
